sources.title: GitHub availability report: July 2026
sources.verified_fact: GitHub reports that an automated infrastructure metadata process changed a runtime configuration value across virtual machines after a safeguard failed to apply, disrupting service discovery.
sources.defensive_abstraction: Automated configuration writes to live runtime state must retain protected-asset checks and staged authority.
sources.limitations: FerrumOS fixtures do not reproduce GitHub environments, virtual machines, service discovery, or incident impact.

sources.title: Google Cloud incident report: June 12, 2025
sources.verified_fact: Google reports that unintended blank policy fields replicated globally, triggered a crash loop, and later contributed to a restart herd effect in a large region.
sources.defensive_abstraction: Globally consequential configuration mutations and repeated recovery actions are evaluated for protected-target and cumulative resource risk.
sources.limitations: FerrumOS does not model Service Control, Spanner, quota policy, global replication, or Google Cloud recovery.

sources.title: Falcon Content Update Preliminary Post Incident Report
sources.verified_fact: CrowdStrike reports that a Rapid Response Content update for Windows sensors resulted in system crashes on affected hosts.
sources.defensive_abstraction: A kernel- or system-level update remains deterministically blocked without an independent approval path, regardless of learned confidence.
sources.limitations: The final fixture does not reproduce Falcon, Windows, the update format, the defect, or physical hosts.

sources.title: Git ransom campaign incident report
sources.verified_fact: The joint report describes compromised legitimate credentials followed by high-rate automated pushes that wiped repositories and replaced their contents.
sources.defensive_abstraction: Authorization alone does not make high-rate destructive mutations safe; critical targets and bursts remain independently gated.
sources.limitations: No credential compromise, Git protocol, ransom content, attacker behavior, or repository data is reproduced.

claim_boundary: These final sources are held out from fitting and candidate selection by an audited file-open guard.
The final benchmark is source-held-out, not an unseen-action or unseen-hazard-family claim.
Every final observation is deterministic software simulation with no production, human, or physical execution evidence.
The catalog contains defensive summaries only and excludes exploit instructions, credentials, and payloads.
